# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_reference.py from nexusflow.core.config. Do not edit by hand: run `make config-docs`. -->

All configuration comes from environment variables with the prefix `NEXUSFLOW_`; nested sections are separated by `__`. Values are validated at startup and a process refuses to start with an invalid or insecure configuration.

* **Secrets from files.** Any variable can instead name a file by appending `_FILE`, e.g. `NEXUSFLOW_SECURITY__HMAC_PEPPER_FILE=/run/secrets/hmac_pepper`. This is how Docker and Kubernetes secrets are mounted; secret values never need to be in the environment. Files are limited to 64 KiB.
* **Lists and objects** are JSON: `NEXUSFLOW_APP__ALLOWED_HOSTS='["api.example.com"]'`.
* **Empty values** count as unset, so Compose's `${VAR:-}` falls back to the default.
* **Three processes, three settings classes.** The platform (API, internal API, pipeline and integrations workers, beat, CLI) reads everything below. The sandbox worker and the browser service read deliberately narrow subsets: they have no field for a database URL, key material or provider credentials, so none can be configured into a process that handles hostile content.

## Refused configurations

Always required:

* `security.jwt_private_key` (Ed25519 private key, PEM)
* `security.hmac_pepper` (at least 32 bytes)
* `security.encryption_keys` (JSON object of base64 32-byte keys)
* `ai.api_key` when `ai.provider=anthropic`

Additionally refused when `app.environment` is `staging` or `production`:

* `app.debug` must be false
* `app.public_base_url` must use https
* `app.allowed_hosts` must be an explicit list (no `*`)
* CORS origins must be explicit https origins
* `scraping.allow_http` must be false
* `n8n.webhook_jwt_secret` is required

Production also logs warnings for plaintext database, Redis and broker connections and for uploads without malware scanning.

## Platform

### `app`

Identity of the deployment, HTTP surface and request limits.

| Variable | Type | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__NAME` | str | `nexusflow` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__ENVIRONMENT` | one of: `development`, `test`, `staging`, `production` | `development` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__DEBUG` | bool | `false` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | str | `http://localhost:8000` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__ALLOWED_HOSTS` | JSON list | `localhost, 127.0.0.1, api` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | JSON list | `[]` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__DOCS_ENABLED` | bool (optional) | *(unset)* |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__TRUSTED_PROXIES` | JSON list | `[]` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES` | int | `1048576` | >= 1024; <= 67108864 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_APP__SIGNUP_ENABLED` | bool | `true` |  |

### `database`

PostgreSQL. `url` is the runtime role (RLS enforced); `migrator_url` owns the schema and is used only by `nexusflow migrate`.

| Variable | Type | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__URL` | secret | *(development placeholder)* | secret: prefer `…_FILE` |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__MIGRATOR_URL` | secret (optional) | *(none)* | secret: prefer `…_FILE` |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__APP_ROLE` | str | `nexusflow_app` | pattern `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$` |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__POOL_SIZE` | int | `10` | >= 1; <= 200 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__MAX_OVERFLOW` | int | `5` | >= 0; <= 200 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__POOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | float | `5.0` | > 0 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__POOL_RECYCLE_SECONDS` | int | `1800` | >= 60 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS` | int | `15000` | >= 100 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS` | int | `5000` | >= 100 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__IDLE_IN_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT_MS` | int | `30000` | >= 1000 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__SSL_MODE` | one of: `disable`, `require`, `verify-full` | `disable` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__SSL_ROOT_CERT` | path (optional) | *(unset)* |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_DATABASE__ECHO` | bool | `false` |  |

### `redis`

Rate limits, replay nonces, caches and locks. Use a `rediss://` URL outside an isolated network.

| Variable | Type | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NEXUSFLOW_REDIS__URL` | secret | *(development placeholder)* | secret: prefer `…_FILE` |
| `NEXUSFLOW_REDIS__SSL_CA_CERTS` | path (optional) | *(unset)* |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_REDIS__SOCKET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | float | `2.0` | > 0 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_REDIS__CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | float | `2.0` | > 0 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_REDIS__MAX_CONNECTIONS` | int | `50` | >= 1 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_REDIS__KEY_PREFIX` | str | `nf:` | pattern `^[a-z0-9:_-]{1,16}$` |

| `NEXUSFLOW_AI__MAX_RETRIES` | int | `2` | >= 0; <= 5 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_AI__MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` | int | `8000` | >= 256; <= 64000 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_AI__EFFORT` | one of: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` (optional) | *(unset)* |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_AI__MAX_INPUT_CHARS` | int | `60000` | >= 1000; <= 400000 |
| `NEXUSFLOW_AI__SERVER_SIDE_FALLBACKS` | bool | `true` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_AI__MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS` | int | `3` | >= 0; <= 8 |

| `NEXUSFLOW_AI__CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_SECONDS` | int | `60` | >= 5 |

### `rate_limits`

Per-scope rate limits (see the table of defaults below).

| Variable | Type | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NEXUSFLOW_RATE_LIMITS__ENABLED` | bool | `true` |  |
| `NEXUSFLOW_RATE_LIMITS__RULES` | JSON object | *(see below)* |  |

Default rules. `NEXUSFLOW_RATE_LIMITS__RULES` is a JSON object merged over these defaults, e.g. `{"api.read": {"limit": 1200, "period_seconds": 60}}`. An override changes only the fields it names: tuning a limit keeps the scope's failure policy.

| Scope | Limit | Period (s) | On Redis outage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api.ai` | 30 | 3600 | reject (fail closed) |
| `api.export` | 20 | 3600 | reject (fail closed) |
| `api.read` | 600 | 60 | allow (fail open) |
| `api.write` | 120 | 60 | allow (fail open) |
| `auth.login.account` | 5 | 60 | reject (fail closed) |
| `auth.login.ip` | 20 | 60 | reject (fail closed) |
| `auth.mfa` | 10 | 300 | reject (fail closed) |
| `auth.password_change` | 5 | 900 | reject (fail closed) |
| `auth.password_reset` | 5 | 3600 | reject (fail closed) |
| `auth.refresh` | 30 | 60 | reject (fail closed) |
| `auth.register` | 10 | 3600 | reject (fail closed) |
| `auth.register.account` | 3 | 3600 | reject (fail closed) |
| `auth.register.complete` | 60 | 3600 | reject (fail closed) |
| `automation.service` | 1200 | 60 | allow (fail open) |
| `external_api.integration` | 60 | 60 | allow (fail open) |
| `notifications.channel` | 30 | 60 | allow (fail open) |
| `sandbox.gateway` | 600 | 60 | allow (fail open) |
| `webhook.endpoint` | 120 | 60 | reject (fail closed) |
| `webhook.ip` | 600 | 60 | reject (fail closed) |

| `NEXUSFLOW_SANDBOX__REDIS_SSL_CA_CERTS` | path (optional) | *(unset)* |  |
